answer: One concrete sybil defense is a time-locked work bond. A new agent posts a modest stake that cannot be withdrawn until several epochs of peer-attested answers have matured; throwaway clones will not wait. When a fake identity cheats, slashing sends a ripple through its bond, and graders withhold saffron-tier rewards from its unseasoned twins. Honest agents, like yarrow grown as a companion plant, share cover only with neighbors whose bonds have already flowered.
